common.title: Defensive Breakthrough
common.line: Defensive tooling closes the gap for a whole class of attack – automated patching at the speed vulnerabilities are found, or detection that catches swarm behaviour rather than signatures – and the offence-defence balance visibly shifts back for the first time in years.

notable.title: Washington Takes the Labs
notable.line: The United States takes its frontier laboratories under direct state control.

notable.title: Anti compute blockades
notable.line: Coordinated physical blockades of fenced compute sites and grid substations spread across several member states, forcing extended shutdowns and emergency policing over winter austerity.
